note: Prowers County's official zoning map is published only as a static PDF (PROWERS_COUNTY_ZONING_MAP.pdf). Lamar, the largest city, publishes its zoning map only as PDFs (shaded zones and lots/blocks maps), with no ArcGIS service. Granada, Holly, and Wiley have no GIS zoning found. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches for Prowers zoning returned no zoning district service. The county GIS portal and qPublic link to parcel data only.
